text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? There is an unfamiliar dessert here,
isn't there? Let me see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My! "Conquer the Peak of Calories!
Whip Mountain☆ Rich Ultimate Pudding"!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Peeking out from beneath an avalanche of rich whipped cream, the pudding looks astonishingly smooth...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And it's today only, you say!?
*Gulp*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, I feel like my body has been a bit heavy lately. I-I must endure this with an iron will...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
............I won!
Yes, a total and complete victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come, Trainer-san, let's go for a run!
Right now, I just want to lose myself in something...!

Displaying tremendous focus, Mejiro McQueen
slyly managed to shed some weight as well.
